# Expression reference

`core/expressions.py`'s grammar: a restricted-Python AST allow-list, never `eval`/`exec`.

## Grammar

| Category | Allowed |
|---|---|
| Constants | int, float, str, bool, None |
| Names | `entity`, `TNOW` / `now`, `true` / `false`, submodel parameters, model variables |
| Attributes | `entity.<name>`; `self.<name>` in an agent type's expressions (its attributes, `self.state`, `self.id`); `AGENT("pop", i).<name>`; no leading `_`. `payload` in a message transition's guard and actions |
| Operators | `+ - * / // % **`, unary `+ - not`, `and`/`or`, comparisons, `in`/`not in` against a tuple or list literal, `a if c else b`, tuple and list literals |
| Calls | the functions below, positional arguments only |

## Functions

| Function | Arguments | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ACOS` | 1 | math.acos, radians |
| `ACTIVE_INITIAL` | 2 | ACTIVE_INITIAL(x, init): x while running, init when initial values are set up |
| `AGENT` | 2 | AGENT("pop", i): a reference to agent i (what entity.agent holds and a send takes); AGENT("pop", i).attr reads its attribute |
| `ALIVE` | 1 | ALIVE(ref): whether a stored agent reference (AGENT(...), entity.agent) still names its agent; using one whose agent was removed raises |
| `ASIN` | 1 | math.asin, radians |
| `ATAN` | 1 | math.atan, radians |
| `ATAN2` | 2 | ATAN2(y, x): math.atan2, radians in (-pi, pi] |
| `AUX` | 1 | auxiliary NAME, evaluated on read |
| `AVAILABLE` | 1 | capacity in force at resource NAME, seized units NOT deducted (free units: IDLE) |
| `CELL_COUNT` | 1..3 | CELL_COUNT("pop"[, dx, dy]): pop's agents in self's grid cell (or an offset from it), self included; 0 off a bounded grid |
| `CONV` | 1 | CONV("name"): the product rate of delayed conversion NAME right now, per its time_unit |
| `COS` | 1 | math.cos, radians |
| `COSH` | 1 | math.cosh, radians |
| `COUNT` | 1..4 | COUNT("pop"[, "state"][, "attr", "value"]): a population's live agents, those in a state (O(1)), or those whose categorical attribute holds that category |
| `DEG` | 1 | radians to degrees |
| `DELAY` | 1 | output of delay NAME |
| `DELAY1` | 2..3 | DELAY1(x, tau[, init]): first-order material delay (init defaults to x at t0); needs simulation.sd |
| `DELAY3` | 2..3 | DELAY3(x, tau[, init]): third-order material delay (init defaults to x at t0); needs simulation.sd |
| `DELAYN` | 3..4 | DELAYN(x, tau, n[, init]): n-th order material delay, n a literal integer (init defaults to x at t0) |
| `DELAYP` | 2..3 | DELAYP(x, tau[, init]): x exactly tau later (pipeline); no grid needed |
| `DISC` | 2..n | value/prob pairs (>= 1 pair), probs must sum to 1 |
| `DISTANCE` | 2 | DISTANCE("a", "b"): shortest path along the path network between two nodes, stations or aliases |
| `EXPO` | 1 | exponential(mean), sampled from the calling block's own rng |
| `FLOW` | 1 | FLOW("name"): the rate flow NAME moves right now, after saturation, per its rate_time_unit |
| `FLOWSUM` | 1..2 | FLOWSUM("tag"[, p]): the rates of every flow tagged TAG (priority below p), per their rate_time_unit |
| `FORECAST` | 3 | FORECAST(x, avg_time, horizon): x extrapolated horizon ahead along its TREND |
| `FRACTION` | 2 | FRACTION("name", "component"): the share of blended level (or conversion) NAME that is COMPONENT |
| `IDLE` | 1 | free units of resource NAME: nothing holds them now (AVAILABLE minus the seized) |
| `IF` | 3 | IF(c, a, b): a when c else b; only the branch taken is evaluated |
| `INITIAL` | 1 | INITIAL(x): the value x had at t=0, held for the whole run |
| `IS_LINKED` | 1 | IS_LINKED(ref): whether self is linked to that agent (directed: self -> it) |
| `KNN_MEAN` | 3..4 | KNN_MEAN("pop", "attr", k[, "state"]): attr's mean over the k nearest agents of pop to self (state-filtered first, ties by ascending index); 0 if none |
| `KNN_SUM` | 3..4 | KNN_SUM("pop", "attr", k[, "state"]): attr summed over the k nearest agents of pop to self (state-filtered first, ties by ascending index); 0 if none |
| `LEVEL` | 1 | LEVEL("name"): the current value of level NAME |
| `LINKED` | 1..2 | LINKED("pop"[, "state"]): how many agents self is linked to (pop is self's own population; directed: its out-links) |
| `LINK_MEAN` | 1..2 | LINK_MEAN("attr"[, "state"]): attr's mean over self's linked neighbours; 0 if none |
| `LINK_SUM` | 1..2 | LINK_SUM("attr"[, "state"]): attr summed over self's linked neighbours; 0 if none |
| `MEAN` | 1..3 | MEAN(x): SUM(x) divided by the element count (subscripts); MEAN("pop", "attr"[, "state"]): an attribute's mean over a population (in that state; 0 if none) |
| `MODULO` | 2 | MODULO(a, b): the remainder of a / b with the sign of a |
| `MR` | 1 | units currently scheduled at resource/set NAME (net of capacity-schedule/failure blockers) |
| `NEAR` | 2..3 | NEAR("pop", r[, "state"]): how many of pop's agents are within r of self (inclusive), self excluded when pop is self's own population |
| `NEAREST` | 1..2 | NEAREST("pop"[, "state"]): distance to the closest OTHER agent of pop (inf if there is none) |
| `NEAR_HEADING` | 2..3 | NEAR_HEADING("pop", r[, "state"]): the circular mean heading of the agents NEAR counts; NaN if none |
| `NEAR_MAX` | 3..4 | NEAR_MAX("pop", "attr", r[, "state"]): attr's maximum over the agents NEAR counts; NaN if none |
| `NEAR_MEAN` | 3..4 | NEAR_MEAN("pop", "attr", r[, "state"]): attr's mean over the agents NEAR counts; 0 if none |
| `NEAR_MIN` | 3..4 | NEAR_MIN("pop", "attr", r[, "state"]): attr's minimum over the agents NEAR counts; NaN if none |
| `NEAR_SUM` | 3..4 | NEAR_SUM("pop", "attr", r[, "state"]): attr summed over the agents NEAR counts; 0 if none |
| `NEIGHBOURS` | 1..2 | NEIGHBOURS("pop"[, "state"]): pop's agents in the Moore/von Neumann cells around self's (own cell excluded) |
| `NEIGHBOUR_MEAN` | 2..3 | NEIGHBOUR_MEAN("pop", "attr"[, "state"]): attr's mean over the agents NEIGHBOURS counts; 0 if none |
| `NEIGHBOUR_SUM` | 2..3 | NEIGHBOUR_SUM("pop", "attr"[, "state"]): attr summed over the agents NEIGHBOURS counts; 0 if none |
| `NOISE_NORMAL` | 4 | NOISE_NORMAL(mean, sd, lo, hi): a normal draw clipped to [lo, hi], redrawn at each re-evaluation, fixed per call site and seed |
| `NORM` | 2 | normal(mean, sd), sampled from the calling block's own rng |
| `NPV` | 4 | NPV(stream, rate, init, factor): present value of a stream discounted at rate, from init, times factor; needs simulation.sd for the step |
| `NQ` | 1 | entities waiting for resource/set NAME |
| `NR` | 1 | entities/units currently in service at resource/set NAME |
| `NS` | 1 | items currently in store NAME (a Hold/Batch/Match store, by block or store name) |
| `PATCH` | 1..3 | PATCH("name"[, dx, dy]): the patch value at self's grid cell (or an offset from it); 0 off a bounded grid |
| `PI` | 0 | PI(): 3.14159... |
| `POWER` | 1 | POWER("name"): kW resource, fleet or charger NAME draws now, from its "power" per state; a flow it feeds takes rate_time_unit hours |
| `PROD` | 1 | PROD(x): x multiplied over every element its "[*]" index runs over (subscripts) |
| `PULSE` | 3 | PULSE(h, t0, w): h on [t0, t0 + w), else 0 |
| `RAD` | 1 | degrees to radians: COS(RAD(self.heading)) |
| `RAMP` | 2..3 | RAMP(s, t0[, t1]): s * (TNOW - t0) after t0, held after t1 |
| `RAND` | 0 | uniform [0, 1), sampled from the calling block's own rng |
| `SAMPLE_IF_TRUE` | 3 | SAMPLE_IF_TRUE(cond, x, init): the last x read while cond was true, init before the first true reading |
| `SIN` | 1 | math.sin, radians |
| `SINH` | 1 | math.sinh, radians |
| `SMOOTH` | 2..3 | SMOOTH(x, tau[, init]): first-order information delay (init defaults to x at t0); needs simulation.sd |
| `SMOOTH3` | 2..3 | SMOOTH3(x, tau[, init]): third-order information delay (init defaults to x at t0); needs simulation.sd |
| `SQRT` | 1 | math.sqrt (the upper-case twin of sqrt) |
| `STEP` | 2 | STEP(h, t0): h from t0 on, else 0 |
| `SUM` | 1..3 | SUM(x): x summed over every element its "[*]" (or subrange "[North*]") indexes run over (subscripts); SUM("pop", "attr"[, "state"]): an attribute summed over a population's agents (in that state) |
| `TABLE` | 2..3 | a value from the model's lookup table NAME, by 1 or 2 keys |
| `TABLE_EXTRAPOLATE` | 2..3 | TABLE_EXTRAPOLATE("name", k1[, k2]): like TABLE, but a linear axis continues past its ends along its last slope instead of clamping |
| `TAN` | 1 | math.tan, radians |
| `TANH` | 1 | math.tanh, radians |
| `TREND` | 2..3 | TREND(x, avg_time[, init]): fractional rate of change of x against its avg_time-smoothed value (init: the starting trend, default 0) |
| `TRIA` | 3 | triangular(low, mode, high), sampled from the calling block's own rng |
| `TS` | 1..2 | TS("name"[, t]): time-series input NAME now, or at time t |
| `UNIF` | 2 | uniform(low, high), sampled from the calling block's own rng |
| `VAR` | 1 | VAR("name"): model variable NAME, for a name a bare name cannot spell |
| `VMAX` | 1 | VMAX(x): the largest x over every element its "[*]" index runs over (subscripts) |
| `VMIN` | 1 | VMIN(x): the smallest x over every element its "[*]" index runs over (subscripts) |
| `XIDZ` | 2..3 | XIDZ(a, b[, x]): a / b, or x (default 0) when b is 0 |
| `ZIDZ` | 2 | ZIDZ(a, b): a / b, or 0 when b is 0 |
| `abs` | 1 | plain Python |
| `ceil` | 1 | math.ceil |
| `exp` | 1 | math.exp |
| `float` | 1 | plain Python |
| `floor` | 1 | math.floor |
| `int` | 1 | plain Python |
| `log` | 1..2 | 1-2 args, math.log |
| `log10` | 1 | math.log10 |
| `max` | 1..n | variadic, plain Python |
| `min` | 1..n | variadic, plain Python |
| `round` | 1..2 | 1-2 args, plain Python |
| `sqrt` | 1 | math.sqrt |
